title: Execution boundaries
description: How the lanes that run a target repository's own build and test code execute it. none: directly, on a disposable copy with a scrubbed environment (the default); podman: inside a rootless, cap-dropped, network-less nested container, and a lane whose runtime cannot run reports not_attempted instead of weakening the boundary. A Tier 2 setting: a scope-ref document imported whole with no assessment and versioned by traust-core's settings service (`traust settings`), so a change is a successor version with its `revision`, never an edit; readers take the latest.

revision.description: Who set this version and why. Written by traust-core's settings service from the verified caller (or the recording run) and its clock; a caller never supplies it.

set_by.description: The principal (<kind>:<identity>) or run that set this version.

reason.description: Why it changed, in the setter's words.
